name: rarestg-skills
description: Personal AI coding agent skills and SOPs

scripts.format: npm run format:docs && npm run format:python
scripts.format:python: ruff check skills/github-review-workflow/scripts skills/github-review-workflow/tests --fix && ruff format skills/github-review-workflow/scripts skills/github-review-workflow/tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:node && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:node: for file in scripts/*.mjs skills/export-traces-transcript/scripts/*.mjs skills/export-traces-transcript/tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done
scripts.lint:python: ruff check skills/github-review-workflow/scripts skills/github-review-workflow/tests && ruff format --check skills/github-review-workflow/scripts skills/github-review-workflow/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run test:repo
scripts.check:fix: npm run format && npm run check
